items.source: Parses the given string representation of a version into a Version object.
items.translation: 将给定字符串形式的版本解析为Version对象。

items.source: Returns whether the current Version is the same as the given one.
items.translation: 返回当前Version是否与给定版本相同。

items.source: Returns whether the current Version is greater (newer) than the given one.
items.translation: 返回当前Version是否大于（更新）给定的版本。

items.source: Returns whether the current Version is greater (newer) or the same as the given one.
items.translation: 返回当前Version是否大于（更新）或等于给定版本。

items.source: Returns whether the current Version is less (older) than the given one.
items.translation: 返回当前Version是否小于（旧于）给定版本。

items.source: Returns whether the current Version is less (older) or equal to the current one.
items.translation: 返回当前Version是否小于（旧于）或等于当前版本。

items.source: Core utility APIs such as a type information framework to resolve generic types.
items.translation: 核心实用 API，例如用于解析泛型类型的类型信息框架。

items.source: Value object to represent a Version consisting of major, minor and bugfix part.
items.translation: 表示由主版本号、次版本号和修正号组成的版本的值对象。

items.source: Returns the Java version of the running JVM.
items.translation: 返回运行中 JVM 的 Java 版本。
